topic.title: LEGO Lost DKK 1.4 Billion in 2003. Then It Went Back to the Brick

cta: Brick or theme park: which one would you have kept? Comment
subject: LEGO
title: LEGO Almost Went Broke, and Kids Still Loved the Brick
description:
Why did LEGO almost go broke while kids still loved the brick?
The toy maker had drifted far from the brick; going back to it turned the company around.
Sources: The Motley Fool, The LEGO Group (Dec 2025).
Based on public records and reporting. Not financial or legal advice.
